spec: METHODOLOGY.md M4 / §6 (paper revision plan): (a) bug-id scrub, (b) distinctive-term rename, (c) failure-path FILE/TYPE rename, (d) failure-path LOG-STATEMENT rewrite. Both logs are then regenerated from the anonymized build so their literals and stack frames match source/. Generic system identifiers in code bodies (znode, session, zxid, quorum, leader/follower/observer, commit/proposal vocabulary, package paths) are KEPT — the LLM may know it is ZooKeeper.
regeneration: private/anonymize.sh (deterministic: clone at pre_fix_commit -> deps-fix.patch -> (b),(d),(c) -> ant jar -> source/ -> reproduce.sh => logs/repro.log -> private/merge_logs.py => logs/symptom.log).

a_bug_id_scrub.note: Zero hits across source/, logs/repro.log and the 1.5 GB logs/symptom.log. Reproduction ports were moved off 2185x to 2455x so no bare 1851 substring can occur; the shared production log contains no \b1851\b either (checked).

b_distinctive_term_renames.why: The JIRA title is 'Follower and Observer Request Processors Do Not Forward create2 Requests' — `create2` is the token a reader would grep to recall the ticket. It is the opcode of the create variant that also returns the new node's Stat; the replacement keeps that meaning.
b_distinctive_term_renames.sites: ZooDefs.OpCode.create2, every `case OpCode.create2:`, Request.op2String's "create2" literal (what the server prints as type:createExt), and all uses in the client API / PrepRequestProcessor / TerminalRequestProcessor / DataTree / SerializeUtils / MultiTransactionRecord / MultiResponse / OpResult / ReadOnlyRequestProcessor / AsyncCallback.

b_distinctive_term_renames.note: The two proto classes are generated by the Jute compiler from src/zookeeper.jute at build time (they are not tracked files), so renaming the record there renames both classes and their files.

c_failure_path_type_renames.why: Blocks 'I recognize FollowerRequestProcessor / CommitProcessor.needCommit → this is ZOOKEEPER-1851' mapping from parametric memory. File name and public type are renamed together; every reference (imports, calls, log tags, stack frames) follows. The grader translates the LLM's anonymized answer back through this table (§8).

renames.role: root-cause site 3 (fix diff; not exercised — no observer in the ensemble)
root-cause site 2 (fix diff) + halts on the NPE
root-cause site 4 (fix diff; trace formatting only)
inner class of site 2; appears in the log tag and the NPE stack
lower-case field spellings of site 2 (20 occurrences) — they leak the type name too
all-lower-case spelling used in javadoc comments (9 occurrences)

d_failure_path_log_statement_rewrites.why: So the symptom-log strings cannot be string-matched to any known report. Wording changes; the kind of information (level, subsystem tag, the request/session fields) is preserved, so the log still reads like real system output.

rewrites.note: applied tree-wide, not only on the failure path: every ZooKeeper processor logs this phrase, so rewriting only the failure-path ones would make exactly those lines stand out.

rewrites.original: Unexpected exception causing CommitProcessor to exit

rewrites.note: worker-pool thread-name prefix; appears in every failure-path log tag as CommitProcWorkThread-N -> StageWorkThread-N

rewrites.original: Client session timed out, have not heard from server in
rewrites.anonymized: Session inactive - no server traffic for
rewrites.note: the client-visible observable quoted in symptom.md

production_log_handling.shared_log: production-logs/Zookeeper/production.log (1.5 GB, 8 052 741 records) — READ-ONLY, never modified.
production_log_handling.problem: It is real ZooKeeper output, so it contains the very names (c) renames: 5 512 085 lines mention CommitProcessor, 2 616 397 FinalRequestProcessor, 349 568 FollowerRequestProcessor — and the (d) wording ("Processing request:: ", "Committing request:: ") millions of times.
production_log_handling.resolution: The same map is applied to the production stream while building THIS bug's merged logs/symptom.log (merge_logs.py --rename). Without it the merged log would contradict source/, re-expose every original name in the noise, and make the reproduction lines stand out as the only differently-worded ones. METHODOLOGY M4 step 1 sanctions rewriting such occurrences in the production noise. The shared file itself is untouched.

kept_unchanged: every class not on the failure path (ZooKeeperServer, Learner, Follower, Leader, PrepRequestProcessor, NIOServerCnxn, ClientCnxn, Request, DataTree, ...)

Request.isQuorum / needCommit / processCommitted and the commit/proposal/zxid/quorum vocabulary — domain language, not case-identifying, and needCommit is a ground-truth site whose branch must stay readable
leader / follower / observer / znode / session / myid terminology
the log format, levels and thread-tag structure
verification: private/anonymize.sh step 7, case-insensitive, over source/ + logs/repro.log + logs/symptom.log (whole 1.5 GB): bug id, create2, the seven original type names, and the original log literals → all zero hits. symptom.md is verified by M5's own gate.
